title: Coverage A Realignment Endorsement for CondoGuard Unit Owners
content:
A Coverage A realignment brings Coverage A on a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy up to the tier's minimum for the association's master policy type. It is made midterm, at the named insured's request, by a Coverage A endorsement that the service representative records.

## Effective date

A Coverage A realignment takes effect on the day the named insured requests it, and that day is before the expiration date.

## What the endorsement records

One call records the Coverage A endorsement, with the new Coverage A limit, its full-year premium effect and the premium charged for the rest of the term, marked as additional premium. It sets the Coverage A limit shown on the declarations to the new limit and posts the charge as an additional-premium entry on the policy's premium account, raising the amount owed by that charge. On success the declarations show the new Coverage A limit and the premium account shows the new charge, effective the day it is recorded.

## Invocation

The tool is `raise_coverage_a_minimum_ec3d8a44`, an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `condo_policy_id` | the reference number of the CondoGuard policy being endorsed, as returned by the condo policy lookup for the verified customer | reference number, text |
| `coverage_a_limit` | the new Coverage A limit the declarations will show | USD, 2 decimal places, stored exactly as passed |
| `annual_premium_change` | the full-year premium effect of the raise | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored |
| `prorated_premium` | the premium charged for the rest of the current term | USD, 2 decimal places, a positive amount, rounded half-up to the cent when stored and posted as the additional-premium charge |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` `coverage_a_raised`, with `endorsement_id` (reference number of the new endorsement entry), `billing_id` (reference number of the additional-premium entry), `condo_policy_id` (the policy endorsed), `coverage_a_limit` (the Coverage A now on the declarations, USD), `effective_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `prorated_premium` (the charge posted, USD).

## Illustration (hypothetical values, not a quote)

A call with `coverage_a_limit` 60000.00, `annual_premium_change` 41.13 and `prorated_premium` 22.54 returns `status` `coverage_a_raised` and `coverage_a_limit` 60000.0, dated today; the premium account owes 22.54 USD more than before.
